items.title: "Why would I deceive you?": Nathan Fielder's Elizabeth Holmes teaser
items.summary: A24 dropped the first teaser for You Can See Everything, Nathan Fielder and Lance Oppenheim's secret documentary following Theranos founder Elizabeth Holmes in the days before she went to prison, as it premiered by surprise at the Telluride Film Festival. The minute-long teaser is almost entirely the two staring each other down while Holmes insists, "Why would I deceive you? There's no reason for me to do that." A24's post got 81K likes, and "Why would I deceive you?" became a meme format of its own.
